data.coordinate_system: Canvas anchor=(0.5,0.5), so children use CENTER-ORIGIN: (0,0)=screen center. Visible: x∈[-designWidth/2, designWidth/2], y∈[-designHeight/2, designHeight/2]. Example 1280x720: center=(0,0), visible=(-640,-360)~(640,360). Direct Canvas children should default to position(0,0).
data.bounding_box: Node at (px,py) with size(w,h) and anchor(ax,ay): left=px-w*ax, right=px+w*(1-ax), bottom=py-h*ay, top=py+h*(1-ay). Default anchor=(0.5,0.5). All edges must be within [-designWidth/2, designWidth/2] x [-designHeight/2, designHeight/2].
data.positioning_tips: Center: position=(0,0). Full-screen background: size=designResolution, position=(0,0). Top-right corner: position=(designWidth/2, designHeight/2). Prefer Widget component for responsive positioning over absolute coordinates.
data.touch_targets: Minimum touch target: 44x44 points (88x88 pixels @2x). Recommended: 48x48.
data.colors: Use contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text. Dark text on light bg or vice versa.
data.safe_area: Account for notch/rounded corners: 44pt top, 34pt bottom on iPhone.
data.button_sizes: Small: 120x44, Medium: 200x60, Large: 300x80. Min width = text width + 48.
data.margins: Screen edge: 16-24px. Between elements: 8-16px. Section spacing: 24-48px.
